# DigiCyberCafe
> DigiCyberCafe offers online tools for exam-photo preparation, PDF tasks, biodata creation, invoicing, and other everyday document needs. Processing and data handling vary by tool; see each tool page and the Privacy Policy for details.

## Core capabilities
- Resize supported images and PDFs toward a user-selected file-size target in the browser; whether a target can be reached depends on the source file and settings.
- Prepare exam photos with a candidate name and date strip, using configurable dimensions and output options.
- Create passport and visa photo crops using selectable presets or custom dimensions.
- Merge, split, compress, edit, watermark, sign, and convert supported PDF and office documents.
- Build marriage biodata documents and create invoices or quotations with tax fields and optional UPI QR codes.

## Primary endpoints
- [Exam photo with name and date](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/photo-name-date-generator): Prepare a photo with candidate name/date text, select the SSC/UPSC preset (413 × 531 px), and choose optional output settings. Supported image input and export formats are listed in the tool.
- [Target KB file resizer](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/target-kb-file-resizer): Resize supported JPEG, PNG, WebP, and PDF files toward a selected KB target; the browser reports whether it met the requested size.
- [Passport photo maker](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/passport-photo-maker): Crop and adjust a photo using India, US/Visa/Schengen, Europe/UK/Australia, or custom dimension presets. Verify current destination requirements before use.
- [PDF workspace](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/pdf): Browse PDF conversion, merging, splitting, compression, editing, signing, and watermarking tools.
- [Marriage biodata maker](https://www.digicybercafe.online/builder/biodata): Create and export a marriage biodata profile.
- [Invoice and quotation generator](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/free-invoice-generator): Prepare quotations, invoices, and related business documents with optional tax and UPI QR details.
- [Barcode and QR code generator](https://www.digicybercafe.online/tools/barcode-qr-generator): Generate supported barcode and QR code formats.

## Privacy and processing
- Processing differs between features. Many file-editing workflows run in the browser; account storage, media extraction, translation, and other external-service features may send information to servers or third parties.
- Read the processing and privacy notes on the specific tool page and the [Privacy Policy](https://www.digicybercafe.online/privacy-policy).
- Publisher/operator: Dinesh Kumar, Patna, Bihar 800024, India.
